reviews.text: There are no others
Dr. Veronica and her team are competent, helpful, and meticulous professionals, and above all, they love animals with all their hearts. I would trust them a thousand times over. Thank you so much.

Very knowledgeable and professional. Veronica is a down-to-earth, yet attentive and knowledgeable veterinarian. Her entire staff is very friendly and always available on WhatsApp and in the office. Prices are much lower than average, but they have extensive experience with all types of animals, even the most unique.

I brought my 15-year-old dog to this practice for a checkup and subsequent surgery, and it was the best choice I could have made. From the very first moment, Dr. Veronica and her entire team proved incredibly professional, meticulous, and gifted with rare sensitivity.
At a delicate time for us, given the dog's advanced age, they conveyed great serenity and attention to detail. Their attention didn't stop with the surgery: in the days that followed, they contacted us several times to inquire about the dog's health and to closely monitor her recovery.
A top-notch medical team, humane and competent. Highly recommended to anyone seeking the best for their pets!
Competence and professionalism

I feel like sharing my experience. This vet is absolutely NOT RECOMMENDED when it comes to reptiles. My partner and I took our crested gecko to him a few years ago after he hadn't eaten for days. He told us he was dehydrated (which wasn't true), and after abruptly telling us, and I quote, "Leave them where they live, why bother taking them? They can't live in captivity" (as if his parrots, caged and unable to fly, could live peacefully), he put a needleless syringe filled beyond reasonable limits with mush into his mouth and quickly shot it straight into his stomach without giving him time to digest it. In fact, our gecko vomited after we got home. Fortunately, we then went to another vet, this time a COMPETENT one, who found parasites in our gecko's feces, treated him with antiparasitic therapy, and he was as good as new.

I took my monk parakeet to Croce Clinic for the first time.
The experience was beyond positive. The two doctors are extremely knowledgeable and experienced, and above all, available to provide all the information and guidance needed, with simplicity and a love for this profession. They are definitely a reliable source of guidance, both human and professional!

It was a truly unique experience to meet a truly special and unique team of veterinary specialists, composed of a fantastic doctor, Dr. Veronica Croce, her daughter, and a very friendly Dr. Croce, her father, who was previously the veterinarian at our Rome Zoo for about twenty years!
I met Dr. Veronica after a serious problem with one of my canaries' legs.
Seeing her work with such sweetness, delicacy, and expertise on my canary's legs made me realize how much she must have been trained! I was struck by her great professionalism, her remarkable ability to interact with these tiny creatures, and the great simplicity with which she approached me, explaining what she was doing.
Many will wonder where the uniqueness lies, well! It lies precisely in the great simplicity with which she interacts with the owners of her little patients, knowing how to explain the entire process they will face, and the gentleness with which she cares for them.
Thanks to your skill in treating this large and diverse group of animals, which too few doctors can, my canary is now happy!
Thank you, Dr. Veronica, and thank you to your wonderful son, who, despite his young age, has played a wonderful and active role in the growth of the practice, giving me the opportunity to leave this review!

A special person, a Veterinarian with a capital V, helped me with so much love and dedication, met by chance in a difficult moment for me thanks to my wife who started looking for a very good doctor for exotic animals and not only, I owe her a lot in addition to the psychological support she gave me for my guinea pig, where others went wrong, I will never abandon her, she follows you constantly and above all she responds immediately to requests for help, she truly loves animals and we are deeply grateful to her
Compared to other vets, Veronica has a completely unified approach. She's empathetic, approachable, very clear in her explanations, 100% professional, and thorough.

I took in an elderly cat who had lost her owner, and my girlfriend and I decided to take her for a veterinary visit, likely the first time she'd ever seen one. Searching online for a clinic not far from home, we chose this one based on the numerous positive reviews.

From the moment I booked, I had a great impression: I was contacted via WhatsApp with all the necessary information, clearly and promptly.

The visit with Veronica Croce was a very positive experience. She was extremely clear in her explanations, understood my difficulties in caring for an elderly cat, and had the patience to explain everything to me in detail, also providing practical and helpful advice.

I particularly appreciated her availability: she carefully listened to all my questions and always answered them thoroughly, demonstrating great professionalism and attention to detail.

For now, I can only congratulate her and thank her from the bottom of my heart for her kindness and expertise.

They are the best. Excellent, highly trained, and available to help me whenever I needed it. I have been entrusting the care of my sweet animals to them since 1994. You are the best. I confirm my enormous respect thanks to Dr. Veronica Croce; my tortoise is improving every day. She had fly larvae on her vulva; she promptly cleaned and disinfected it and started her on antibiotics right away. The doctor is excellent and very helpful.

My experience was unique, beautiful, and full of emotion! I brought my little girl named Cocò, convinced she was pregnant. Dr. Veronica, however, immediately saw something was wrong: the puppies weren't moving and there was no heartbeat. She immediately understood that the mass wasn't a litter, but a uterine tumor.
From there, a whirlwind of emotions began, especially because I had already lost Cocò's little sister to the same cause (except the tumor was in her stomach, so it wasn't operable). The doctor, together with Dr. Amerio, suggested that I operate on her. Unfortunately, such a small animal doesn't have a 100% chance of survival... How did it end? I agreed to try the surgery, knowing full well that she might not come home. And yet... Dr. Veronica, Dr. Amerio, and their team of exotic animal experts gave Cocò a second life, completing the operation with a 100% success rate!
I don't know how to thank you SO MUCH 🙏🏼💕
Dr. and Dr. Croce are always very kind and helpful, as well as very professional. The doctor solved my cat's dermatitis problem.
I rushed to the vet (I'm not a client, I should point out) and was treated quite badly by the medical staff, who unfortunately didn't take charge of my dog.

I will never stop thanking the extraordinary Dr. Veronica and her entire staff.
After my elderly dog ​​likely suffered a serious neurological event, I entrusted them with his care, and they treated him with great professionalism, expertise, and a rare level of humanity.
They cared for him every step of the way, with attention, patience, and so much love, literally getting him back on his feet. Seeing his improvements was moving, and I owe it entirely to them.

Thank you so much for treating my dog ​​like family.
Highly recommended to anyone looking for knowledgeable and dedicated veterinarians, but above all, people who truly love animals.
A well-prepared, friendly and very professional doctor who is available even after the visit and who helps and advises you even over the phone.

Today, after leaving this first review, I would like to write in large letters: Thank you, thank you to Dr. Croce and all the wonderful female staff she has! Thank you for giving my crow temporary shelter when I was desperate, thank you for not leaving me alone with my doubts and fears, thank you for showing empathy and kindness in this world inhabited mostly by people who don't care, thank you for making us feel welcomed. Veronica, I will never thank you enough for helping us. I visited eight vets before meeting you, and you were the only ones, and I mean ONLY ones, who didn't give a damn about my Bettina's delicate situation. I have tears in my eyes as I write this review because you have no idea how important and precious your help has been to us.
You're amazing, I love you so much.

I went yesterday for the first time, for my crow. I found Dr. Croce and Dr. Croce to be honest, professional, and respectful—qualities I've never encountered before! And they don't improvise as avian vets, but they know what they're talking about! I adore you. It's a shame I only discovered you now, I would have saved myself so many unnecessary visits with incompetent professionals!
! Thank you for everything.

I am incredibly grateful to everyone for their professionalism, dedication, and the immense affection they showed toward my cat, who was pampered and constantly monitored. I highly recommend this clinic. Thank you.

I had the pleasure of bringing my cat, Gedeone, to the clinic, where he was taken care of by Dr. Dalia, who was simply fantastic. A caring, precise, clear, and compassionate professional! Unfortunately, in the end, there was nothing that could be done for Gedeone...but without Dr. Dalia's support and presence, even remotely, going through that situation would have been much worse. I highly recommend her! And I thank her from the bottom of my heart.
Very knowledgeable and kind doctor, highly recommended

Today we took our dog (Labrador) to them for the first time.
They were helpful, kind, and very thorough, going above and beyond the reason we came.
Highly recommended.
Courtesy and competence,

My experience dates back several years, when unfortunately there weren't any reviews on Google yet. I took several of my exotic pets (mostly mice) for visits. 50 euros each time, even just to look at them. Okay. I took my chipmunk, who had a tumor, for surgery. I should start by saying that the chipmunk was doing fine, except for this huge lump on his chest that prevented him from climbing easily, and he was 6 years old. We asked Dr. Amerio for an opinion, and he told us, "Don't worry, I'll operate on him, he'll be fine." We brought the squirrel in one morning, and picked him up dead in a box that afternoon. He called us at 2 PM, telling us that the operation WAS successful, but he'd lost too much blood and wouldn't make it. And he still asked us for 150 euros. Money first, then everything else. Disgusting.
Dr. Croce is very kind and professional. She examined my little hamster this evening... We'll be back soon.
ENOUGH WITH THIS BIRD I CAN'T STAND IT ANYMORE

Although the facility is a bit dated and not particularly attractive, the clinic is very clean and odor-free. The doctor is kind, empathetic, and very competent. The staff is courteous and helpful. They follow strict sterilization procedures in the operating room, which gives us clients a great deal of peace of mind. Known for neutering two dogs, I will definitely keep her in mind for any needs I may have in Rome.

Dr. Veronica operated on my puppy, Macchia. She and the entire practice are fabulous people: professional, human, and with a level of expertise few can boast!
Thank you so much, Dr. Veronica!

A wonderful place with wonderful doctors, nurses, and practice. My cats used to hate going to the vet, but now they're much calmer, and so am I. They're very thorough and take great care of you, both during and after the visit. I recommend it to everyone.

Doctor Veronica is practically perfection, she represents a mix of professionalism and courtesy, always available, I brought my first setter and now I bring the second one just adopted, believe me she is practically an excellence
Professionalism and humanity go hand in hand at this veterinary clinic. I recommend it for our four-legged friends and beyond.

I had a horrendous experience, not so much for me, but for the budgie we found on Via Nola. You could see from afar that one of its legs was out of order (we finally managed to take it to the LIPU in Rome, whom we thank), and it was NOT neurological. Between waiting and "examining" it, we must have wasted at least 30 minutes, and also 25 euros worth of NOTHING except antibiotics/food, because the vet, who boasts of having worked for years at the LIPU in Rome, had the BRILLIANT idea of ​​taping the wing that was NOT broken, but birds (as the LIPU later explained to me) tend to "not use" that entire body part when they have a leg out of order because they don't feel well (I don't know how else to explain it). And not only did this happen—a pointless thing, then—but my partner and I found the budgie on the street, as I said at the beginning, and we noticed him because he was limping. We IMMEDIATELY realized he had something wrong with his leg (we later discovered, THANKS to the Italian Lipu, that he had a broken femur). That GENIUS of a vet, not only did he LITERALLY pull his entire leg while "examining" him, to "understand" (I can only imagine the pain the bird must have felt), but after taping his wing, he wriggled (rightfully so) and made him "get off" the clinic table on his own, obviously "flying," surely causing him even more pain. On top of all this, they also had the nerve to charge us 25 euros for THIS HORRIBLE and UNPROFESSIONAL service. They thought it was a neurological problem and he wouldn't have survived the night, but instead it was none of those things. A HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE. I don't recommend them to anyone, especially any animal.
